user_request: Build an AI document intelligence platform using AWS. It should allow users to upload PDF documents securely, extract text using OCR, identify PII, and store the metadata in a graph database for relationship querying.
normalized_request: A cloud-hosted document intelligence platform that enables secure PDF upload, OCR-based text extraction, PII detection, and relationship-based metadata storage via graph database querying.

requirements.description: Support secure upload of PDF documents with authentication and encryption
Extract text content from PDF documents using OCR for both digital and scanned PDFs
Detect and classify Personally Identifiable Information (PII) within extracted text
Store extracted metadata and relationships in a queryable graph structure
Enable relationship-based queries across documents and extracted entities
Provide user-facing interface for document upload, viewing, and query execution
Audit and log all document access and PII detection events for compliance

components.name: SECURE_DOCUMENT_UPLOAD_AND_STORAGE
components.description: Manages secure file ingestion with authentication, encryption at rest and in transit, and versioning for PDF documents

components.name: OCR_AND_TEXT_EXTRACTION
components.description: Performs optical character recognition and text extraction from PDF documents, handling both digital and scanned content

components.name: PII_DETECTION_AND_CLASSIFICATION
components.description: Identifies and classifies Personally Identifiable Information in extracted text, including names, emails, phone numbers, SSNs, etc.

components.name: GRAPH_DATABASE_STORAGE
components.description: Stores document metadata, extracted entities, and relationships in a graph structure for querying entity connections and document associations

components.name: GRAPH_QUERY_ENGINE
components.description: Executes relationship-based queries across the graph database to retrieve connected entities, documents, and metadata patterns

components.name: DOCUMENT_PROCESSING_ORCHESTRATION
components.description: Coordinates the workflow between document upload, OCR execution, PII detection, and metadata graph storage with error handling and retry logic

components.name: WEB_INTERFACE
components.description: Provides user interface for document upload, extraction result visualization, graph query interface, and PII redaction/review capabilities

components.name: AUTHENTICATION_AND_AUTHORIZATION
components.description: Manages user authentication, role-based access control, and permission enforcement for document and metadata access

components.name: AUDIT_AND_COMPLIANCE_LOGGING
components.description: Records all document access, PII detection events, queries executed, and data modifications for compliance and forensic analysis

execution_plan.objective: Break down the AI document intelligence platform into discrete technical components: secure PDF upload handling, OCR text extraction, PII detection, graph database storage, and relationship querying capabilities.
Identify publicly available and open-source solutions for AWS-based PDF processing, OCR engines, PII detection libraries, graph databases, and metadata relationship management systems.
Assess each identified candidate solution against requirements for security, scalability, AWS integration, accuracy, maintenance status, and licensing compatibility.
Determine for each component whether to REUSE existing solutions, ADAPT open-source projects, or BUILD custom implementations based on evaluation results.

Create a detailed technical architecture blueprint specifying selected tools, AWS services, integration points, data flow, API contracts, and implementation phases for the document intelligence platform.
Validate the blueprint against security requirements, AWS best practices, scalability constraints, and verify that all components integrate cohesively without conflicts.
